name: ring
crs: D96/TM (EPSG:3794); grid north; heights in metres above the Slovenian height datum (GKOT ground, ARSO DMR1 fill)
row_order: south to north; column order west to east; node (0, 0) at the origin
encoding: gzip of little-endian uint16; height_m = base_m + value * step_m
sources: Digital terrain model DMR1 (LiDAR, 1 m): Ministry of the Environment and Spatial Planning, Slovenian Environment Agency (ARSO)
SRTM data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; Mapzen Terrain Tiles
Cyclic laser scanning of Slovenia 2023-2025 (CLSS), classified point cloud GKOT: Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia (GURS), CC BY 4.0
